items.title: LendingUSA and Cross River Launch Bitcoin-Secured Loans, Giving Bitcoin Holders Access to Funds Without Selling
items.why: Crypto-collateral lending is a new embedded model for affluent holders, with Cross River as the bank partner.
items.summary_ai: LendingUSA and Cross River have launched loans secured by bitcoin, letting holders borrow without selling their coins.
items.take: Crypto-collateral lending is a new embedded model for affluent holders, with Cross River as the bank partner.
